master:
Create ONE strict low resolution pixel-art farmer character, production sprite, not an illustration. Reference image defines the farmer's identity, not the output resolution: warm middle-aged man with large lively eyes, short gray full beard and gray moustache, brown hair, straw hat with green leaves and brown band, rolled cream sleeves, olive apron, brown gloves, trousers and boots, no carrots. Keep the original's adult long torso and legs and friendly confident expression, no chibi widening or tiny doll eyes.
TECHNICAL ART DIRECTOR SPEC: draw on a logical canvas EXACTLY 64 pixels wide by 96 pixels tall. Display the canvas enlarged EXACTLY 16x to 1024x1536, each individual logical pixel is a flat 16x16 square aligned to the canvas origin. NO detail smaller than a logical pixel, no off-grid edges, no antialiasing, no intermediate colors, no blur. Palette max32 flat earthy colors. Single pixel-wide dark brown outline on logical grid, restrained two/three-step material shading, chunky intentional pixel clusters. Genuine transparent background.
Logical full-canvas layout: boots baseline y92, top of hat y4, hat/head/beard stays in y4..35 (32px), torso y36..59 (24px), legs/boots y60..91 (32px). Character centered x32, full figure inside x7..57, arms relaxed with visible hands not crossing torso. Face turned three-quarter toward viewer right as reference. Face has nose and gray sideburns/beard/moustache. Eyes large expressive 4x6 logical pixel shapes with white and dark brown irises, located near logical (35,23) and (43,23). Mouth small smile around (40,30) INSIDE full gray beard. Straw hat separate visibly from hairline, apron clearly distinguishable from shirt. Do not draw background grid or swatches or text. One farmer only, no sprite sheet, no extra views. Professional 64x96 native game sprite enlarged with nearest neighbor, visibly large uniform square pixels.
underlayer:
Edit this exact 64x96 pixel game sprite shown enlarged 8x. Produce the underlying modular BASE sprite in the IDENTICAL canvas, pose, proportions, and pixel alignment. Each existing 8x8 display block is one native pixel; preserve those blocks, do not add subpixel detail or antialiasing.
Remove ONLY these removable layers:
1 Straw hat and green hat leaves: replace with transparent space above his existing brown hair. Complete the simple brown hair top naturally within original hat silhouette, do not change face/head size.
2 Both eyes/eyebrows and the smile mouth line: fill the eye positions with flat matching skin. Fill mouth opening with matching surrounding skin, but KEEP ALL gray beard, gray moustache, nose, ears, hair and face outline. It is a face base without any eyes or mouth, not a featureless head.
3 Olive apron, apron straps, gold buckles, tool belt/pouch: reveal a simple cream shirt torso at exactly the same body shape. Shirt ends at waistband, with plain brown pants continuing underneath the removed apron. No new clothes details.
4 Brown gloves only: reveal empty bare skin-colored hands in exactly same hand shapes. Keep simple brown boots.
Keep entire outer body silhouette, arms, legs, boots, neck, beard, pose and palette as close to image as possible. No props. Genuine transparent PNG. One sprite only. This is an exact aligned paper-doll UNDERLAYER, no expression, no hat, no apron, no gloves.
